commits.subject: fix(reminders): never resume a paused reminder series when a new reminder is added
commits.body: Adding one reminder to a series that had been paused switched the whole series back on. On 12 January that sent 230 patients reminders for appointments that had already been cancelled. A paused series now stays paused; the new reminder starts a series of its own. Adds a paused_at column so a pause survives a restart.

sessions.headline: Paused reminder series no longer resume on a new reminder
sessions.summary: Found why 230 patients got reminders for cancelled appointments: adding a reminder resumed a paused series. A paused series now stays paused and a new reminder starts its own series. Added a paused_at column.
